design_philosophy.core_archetype: Premium Sensory Minimalism + Industrial Technical Authority
signals: Product as Hero (high-contrast product photography on warm off-white/charcoal surfaces)
Quiet luxury, exquisite spacing, material micro-textures, restrained color with single high-visibility safety accent
No medical pastel cliches, no blue-gloved dropship imagery, no skull/tattoo tropes, no fake urgency timers
design_philosophy.theme_mode: Light/Dark hybrid with warm off-white surfaces (#F7F6F3 / #121214) and Charcoal/Near-Black anchors (#0E0F12 / #1A1C20)

rules: Use #FF5500 (Safety Orange) or #FFB800 (Signal Yellow) ONLY for CTAs, active stock status, price break highlights, and primary key interaction triggers.
Never use medical pastel mint, generic baby blue, or full-screen glossy gradients.
All surfaces cut off from header must use semi-solid or glass backdrop blur with explicit text colors (no fully transparent header or dropdowns).

typography.headline_font: Space Grotesk / Cabinet Grotesk / Barlow Condensed (Bold/SemiBold, tracking-tight)
typography.body_font: Inter / DM Sans (Regular/Medium, tracking-normal, tabular figures for specs/prices)
typography.monospace_font: JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono (for mil thickness, pinhole AQL ratings, SKU numbers, box counts)

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-balance
rules.forbidden: NO decorative, blackletter, gothic, or tattoo-styled fonts. Specs & medical/industrial credibility are primary.

layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x default padding). Use p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16 for section rhythm.
layout_and_grids.hero_structure: Split high-impact product spotlight (Black Nitrile Glove + Case Box shot on neutral warm studio ground) + 6 Industry Entry Points directly beneath hero grid.

bento_grid_modes.industry_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 md:gap-6

navigation_and_header.desktop: Sticky top bar with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 dark:bg-black/85 border-b border-border z-50. Must feature: Brand Logo ('PPE PRO SOLUTIONS'), Category Megamenu (By Industry, By Material, All Gloves), Glove Selection Guide Link, Quick Bulk Quote Button, Cart Icon with Badge, and Search Bar.
navigation_and_header.mobile: Sticky header with mobile hamburger drawer + persistent sticky mobile bottom Add-to-Cart bar on Product Detail Pages.
navigation_and_header.rules: Header background must NEVER be transparent. Always set explicit background color and z-50.

components_and_features.catalog_filtering: Filter by Material (Nitrile, Latex, Chloroprene), Thickness (3 mil - 8+ mil), Texture (Full, Palm, Diamond Grip), Color (Black, Cobalt Blue, Violet, White, Green), Industry, and Usage Grade (Exam/Medical, Industrial/Heavy Duty, Food Safe).

product_detail_page.gallery: Multi-angle product view (Box + Individual Glove, Palm Texture close-up, Hand fit stretch, Case Packaging).
product_detail_page.specs_table: Data-dense technical spec sheet tab with Mil Thickness (Palm vs Finger), Tensile Strength (MPa), Elongation (%), AQL Pinhole level (1.5 Exam Grade), Powder Content, Finish, Cuff length, Chemical Resistance matrix.
product_detail_page.variant_selectors: Size Selector (XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL) with live stock indicator per size + Pack Size Selector (Box of 100 vs Case of 1000) + Tiered Volume Price Break table ($/box at 1-4 cases, 5-19 cases, 20+ cases).
product_detail_page.sticky_mobile_cart: Bottom bar containing active price, selected size, and instant 'Add to Cart' button.

industry_landing_pages: Tattoo & Body Art (Tactical Black Nitrile, High Tactility, Ink/Vaseline Slip Resistance)
Beauty & Personal Care (Elegance Violet/Pink/Black, Hair Dye Chemical Resistance)
Medical & Healthcare (Fentanyl Tested, Chemo Rated, AQL 1.5 Medical Grade Nitrile)
Food Service & Processing (FDA Title 21 CFR Compliant, High-Visibility Blue, Textured Grip)
Laboratory & Cleanroom (Powder-Free Chloroprene/Nitrile, Low Extractables, Precision Touch)
Industrial & Automotive (Heavy Duty 6-8 mil Diamond Textured Nitrile, Oil/Solvent Protection)
material_guides: Chloroprene / Neoprene (Latex-like stretch + Nitrile chemical strength)
interactive_tools: Sizing Guide Modal with printable hand measurement chart & palm width calculator
Bulk Custom Quote Request Form with instant quantity tier calculator
Mock Cart & Checkout Flow with shipping calculator and order summary

motion_and_interactions.effects: Subtle image transitions, smooth tab switches, slide-over cart drawer, hover lift on product cards (y: -3px), pulsing live stock status badge.
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion useReducedMotion hook or standard CSS media query.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, filter options, size buttons, price displays, cart items, stock status badges, and tab triggers MUST contain kebab-case data-testid attributes.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML dropdowns/inputs.
Use Shadcn UI components for dropdowns, dialogs, tabs, accordions, toasts, and custom selects.
Add transition effects on specific properties (e.g., transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease) and EXCLUDE transform from global transitions.
All .js / .jsx files in the React codebase must maintain clean modular structures, clear state management (e.g., Zustand or React Context for cart/filters), and accessible keyboard focus states.
Ensure total responsive fidelity across mobile screens (375px), tablets (768px), and wide monitors (1440px+).
